recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-3713 unless a future Patient Care decision changes Procedure.location semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-3713 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 by Patient Care and requested that Procedure be able to document the location where a procedure occurred.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 9c7bb8368a37c9fc77536157561b19965be76867, '#3713 - add location to Procedure', which added Procedure.location as Reference(Location) to the old Procedure spreadsheet and recorded svn revision 4792, matching the Jira comment.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini and the old spreadsheet source has been refactored into source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml. A later Published clarification, FHIR-32508, removed the obsolete requirement tying Procedure.location to where records are kept; that related issue is already audited on the combined branch by f991cc2e4b50c3b5d71e07032fb9a69175acb340.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source defines Procedure.location as a 0..1 Reference(Location) for where the procedure actually happened and the Procedure-location search parameter points to the same element.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the same Procedure.location element by removing the records-storage requirements text; already represented on the combined branch and cited only as context.
